# Independent culture response checks

Before opening numerical measurements, retain the 101 fixed targets and 10,806-gene background. Re-use the day-3 tension-side atlas, the earliest available time, without time scaling. Compare the ratio of day-3 tensile to untreated fibroblast-like expression (with 1 CPM added before division), the previously frozen fixed-share tissue multiplier for the same side/time, and zero. Evaluate each without fitting to either new experiment. Dataset choice uses absence from the previous culture discovery inputs, human primary PDL cells, load direction, public genome-wide measurements and an unloaded comparison.

In the Hong Kong paired culture RNA-seq (GSE173891, 12 hours, 12% strain), compare the five within-donor differences of log2(1 + full-library CPM). Score the mean absolute error across genes within each donor first and then average donors equally. Also calculate the average signed error and the absolute error in the signed panel mean. Report the corresponding gene/panel percentile metrics by ranking each donor's untreated and tensile RNA over the common measured background, averaging tied ranks, and applying each atlas multiplier to the untreated culture CPM before ranking. For replicate-independent forecasting, a zero count for a measured gene is a measured zero. Retain measurable genes and state coverage explicitly. Repeat on the mapped background without changing the parameters. Pair identifiers must be verified from the GEO metadata and primary study.

In the Osaka 48-hour cyclic-stretch dual-channel microarray (GSE19118), examine sample metadata to determine channel orientation, dye-swap and technical units. Use a reported normalized two-channel ratio only if its direction and scale are unambiguous. Resolve probes to a unique target using supplied platform identifiers and stable human gene mappings. Average multiple valid probes for a gene on the log2 scale. Exclude unresolvable probes. Report measured coverage, mean absolute error on log2 gene changes, and the two arrays separately as a consistency check if they represent common material. Do not use unannotated or ambiguous probe signals as zero or use these arrays for donor inference. Assess rank changes only if calibrated individual arm profiles are available and the design supports them. Report the published 72-hour three-donor series separately, whose numerical supplemental coefficients were preselected.

Neither culture experiment includes day-7 human root-face tissue or isolates the atlas mural group. Do not reinterpret either as a same-time replication. The previous article and source-atlas predictions were already examined. No new experimental outcomes informed this rule.
